message: 揚げ玉＝天カス

name: Nanaka
message: 「Mfufu--now that the test results are out, I'm totally off the hook. All's right with the world, no problems at all.」

name: Synn
message: 「...There definitely is one, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ugh... I'm turning over a new leaf for the Holy Night Festival, so don't rain on my parade.」

name: Synn
message: 「You got assigned extra homework instead of remedial classes, didn't you, Nanaka? If you want to give the Holy Night Festival your all, you need to hand that in properly, okay?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's an unwritten rule that homework is meant to be done on Sunday night!」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. I'm glad to hear you're motivated. If today worked for you, I could've kept you company while you did it, though I know you have your own schedule.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Say what!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I'm going home right now and starting on my homework.」

name: Synn
message: 「I wasn't trying to rush you or anything, Nanaka? You can take it slow and finish it properly at your own... hm?」
Suddenly, a shadow falls over me.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey now, don't get so shocked that your whole body goes dark just because I said I'd do my homework.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, that's not it, I--」

name: Sally
message: 「Hyoeeeh, Prez, look ouuut~~~」

name: Paqy
message: 「Jaki!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Guhah.」
Out of nowhere, Sally-chan came crashing down and slammed right into me... or rather, into Paqy, to be exact.

name: Sally
message: 「Kyuru~n\s07 Owwwww...」

name: Sally
message: 「Mm... mmm? Wait, it doesn't actually hurt that much? Awawa, did Paqy act as a cushion for me?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Welp, he took so much damage he passed out.」

name: Sally
message: 「Thanks, Paqy. As a thank-you, I'll give you some pickled red ginger next time.」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't think he wants that... More importantly, why did you fall out of the sky, Sally-chan?」

name: Sally
message: 「Bikkuun! R-Right, that's it.」

name: Sally
message: 「Ugh, *sniffle*, my face huuurts, my forehead is all prickly and my cheeks are tingling, so I can't fly properly!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Really, it's just like an apple.」

name: Synn
message: 「D-Don't tell me you dined and dashed, got caught, and got slapped back and forth across the face!?」

name: Sally
message: 「Hmph! I don't do stuff like that anymore!」

name: Sally
message: 「When I washed my face at Prez's house, it turned out like thiiis!」

name: Synn
message: 「In my kitchen?」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah! I squirted out the stuff that makes dishes clean, and patted it all over!」

name: Synn
message: 「D-Don't tell me that was...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh no, that's dishwashing detergent!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sally-chan, come to Yuugiri-an!」

name: Sally
message: 「The hot towel is so warm and cozy~♪ Nice and toasty, feels so good~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Here, turn your face this way and hold still. Rub, rub, rub.」

name: Sally
message: 「Mmph-mmph.」
After bringing Sally-chan back with her, Nanaka applied milky lotion to her forehead, cheeks, and nose--which had turned red as if from frostbite--and began gently massaging them.
She has the air of a capable older sister looking after a much younger sibling.

name: Nanaka
message: 「I put some cream on Sally's face, so all that's left is--」

name: Sally
message: 「Cream?! *Liiick*~♪」

name: Sally
message: 「Ptooey!! It's bitter! Blech, blech, blech!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Of course it is! It's not soft-serve ice cream or anything!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sally, if you lick it off, your face is gonna start stinging again.」

name: Sally
message: 「A-wawah, brrrrr, sh-sh-shiver!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Honestly, washing your face with dish soap of all things.」

name: Sally
message: 「I'm sooorry~~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That stuff strips way too much oil from your skin.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「With normal facial cleanser, rinsing three or four times is fine, but with dish soap, you have to rinse more than ten times to get it all off.」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah, my face stayed slimy no matter what, so I scrubbed it really hard with water.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And then, right after you wash your face, it feels super refreshing, but your skin heats up right away and starts stinging.」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah, yeah! When I fly in the sky, the cold wind makes it hurt so bad, like, seriously hurt.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tahahaha, so it does hurt, huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「...Hey, Nanaka, don't you know a little too much about this?」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be that you've done the exact same thing as Sally before, Nanaka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「S-Sally, you really need to get some proper oil in your diet. Stay and have some tanuki soba at my place.」

name: Sally
message: 「Yessir! Tempura bits, tempura bits, yay!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-You poor thing. Actually, I'll upgrade you to chikuwa tempura soba.」

name: Sally
message: 「Yippee! I love you, Nanaka!」
After a little while, Nanaka carried out three servings of piping hot soba from the kitchen.
Once we'd filled our stomachs a bit, I helped Nanaka with her homework that day.
Come to think of it, before joining the Student Council, the two of us used to do this all the time.
